column2: [intro]
The alarm rings, I gradually wake up,
My brain activates, dopamine is here,
I dance in the kitchen, eating my breakfast,
The machines are partying, it's my dopamine Party.
In my head, there are lots of little machines,
They make my body move, it's dopamine online,
We have fun, we dance, we feel good,
Dopamine makes our daily lives vibrate.
At work, the machines go wild,
Dopamine gives me wings and amazes me,
Ideas flow, I’m a genius,
The pleasure they create is my dopamine Party.
In my head, there are lots of little machines,
They make my body move, it's dopamine online,
We have fun, we dance, we feel good,
Dopamine makes our daily lives vibrate.
[ solo ]
So join my dopamine Party,
Let the machines make your life more funky,
We’ll sing, we’ll dance until morning,
Because dopamine is my engine, my destiny.
[outro]
